# where type = 0x81 for the GC driver.
# Source: kernel gc_ioctl_internal at 0x6ed39c (BST + 4 jump tables),
# Cross-referenced with libSceAgcDriver.sprx / libSceAgcVsh.sprx ioctl calls.
# The PS5 FW 5.50 gc_ioctl_internal dispatch table handles 76 distinct
# (dir, nr, size) command variants. The table below lists the 46 named
# commands that are currently exposed as macros in include/agc_ioctl.h.
# Other entries are internal-size variants or undocumented commands that
# map to the same nr with different sizes/directions.
#   direction  : IOC direction (NONE / WRITE / READ / RW)
#   size       : arg size in bytes (14 bits)
